title: Central Atlas Tamazight - Wikipedia
text: All five languages may be referred to as "Tamazight", but Central Atlas speakers are the only ones who use the term exclusively. As is typical of Afroasiatic languages, Tamazight has a series of "emphatic consonants" (realized as pharyngealized), uvulars, pharyngeals and lacks the phoneme / p /.

title: Berber languages - Wikipedia
text: Tamazight in Morocco is divided by linguists into three major dialect areas usually referred to as: Taselhit in the south, Tamazight in the Middle Atlas mountains, and Tarifit in the north.

text: Central Atlas Tamazight is also known as Atlasic, Central Shilha, Central Morocco Tamazight, Middle Atlas Tamazight, or simply Tamazight. It is spoken primarily in the Atlas Mountains of Morocco, but there is a small community of speakers in France.

title: Tamazight, Central Atlas | Ethnologue Free
text: Central Atlas Tamazight is an endangered indigenous language of Morocco. It belongs to the Afro-Asiatic language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
